title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide the body with sufficient iron and folate. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. However, many pregnant women struggle to find recipes rich in iron and folate. In this article, we'll introduce three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, providing a nutritious and safe meal for pregnant women.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients for pregnant women. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of the fetus's brain and nervous system. Vitamin C also plays a vital role in enhancing iron absorption. Below are three recipes that combine iron with vitamin C:

* Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
 + 100g grilled chicken (iron: 2.5mg)
 + 100g mixed vegetables (vitamin C: 50mg)
 + 1 cup cooked white rice
* Recipe 2: Beef and Water Spinach Stir-Fry Bowl
 + 100g beef stir-fry (iron: 3.5mg)
 + 100g water spinach (vitamin C: 30mg)
 + 1 cup cooked white rice
* Recipe 3: Baked Fish and Salad Bowl
 + 100g baked fish (iron: 2.5mg)
 + 100g mixed salad (vitamin C: 40mg)
 + 1 cup cooked white rice

## Food Safety Notes
When cooking for pregnant women, it's essential to consider food safety. Below are some important notes:
* Choose fresh and clean ingredients
* Cook food thoroughly before consumption
* Avoid eating undercooked or raw food
* Wash hands before cooking and eating

## Cooking Tips
Here are some cooking tips to help pregnant women have a nutritious and safe meal:
* Use olive oil or coconut oil to enhance nutrient absorption
* Add herbs and spices to increase flavor and nutrition
* Eat a balanced and varied diet to ensure adequate nutrient intake

## Conclusion
The three recipes above combine iron with vitamin C, providing a nutritious and safe meal for pregnant women. Remember to consider food safety and use olive oil or coconut oil to enhance nutrient absorption. For more information on prenatal nutrition, visit our [website](/blog/prenatal-nutrition).

faqs.question: Why are iron and folate important for pregnant women?
faqs.answer: Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus.

faqs.question: How can I increase iron absorption?
faqs.answer: Vitamin C helps increase iron absorption, so consume foods rich in vitamin C along with iron-rich foods.

faqs.question: Can I eat undercooked or raw food?
faqs.answer: No, avoid eating undercooked or raw food to ensure food safety.
